import json,random,ipaddress
random.seed(2)
cases=[]
# one case, 2 versions: version0 with /0 hop0 + 31 singleton /128 spaced by 4 => 63 runs
initial=[["::/0",0]]
for i in range(31):
    # avoid 0 and spread up to near high
    x=(i+1)<<100
    initial.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))+"/128", i+1])
tx=[]
# no-op version 1; same R
bursts=[]
for b in range(256):
    rep=random.randint(1,1000000)
    addrs=[]
    for a in range(32):
        i=random.randint(0,31); x=(i<<100)+(random.randint(0,1000))
        addrs.append(str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x)))
    bursts.append({"version":b%2,"repeat":rep,"addresses":addrs})
cases.append({"initial":initial,"transactions":tx,"bursts":bursts,"cache_pages":12,
              "costs":{"hit":2,"miss":17,"decode":[0,1,2]}})
